title: Normalized correlated sign-vector sum
statement: For $n\in\mathbb N$ and a sequence $z$ of length $n$ whose entries are pairs of signs, take the sum of the correlated sign vectors associated with its entries and multiply by $1/\sqrt n$. The result lies in the two-dimensional Euclidean plane.
hypotheses_covered: A length-$n$ sequence of pairs of signs
caveat: The snippet does not define the correlated sign vector, so its coordinates cannot be rendered more explicitly.
